text.card: A red giant 1,625 parsecs away, 27 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.03 solar masses and 26.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,207 K at its surface.
